assets.name: 04-abstract-folds
assets.prompt: Create a bespoke visual asset for EquipED's faculty dashboard only, an academic learning-material review workspace. This belongs to a coordinated asset family inspired by folded paper and the Folio logo's corner fold, but DO NOT draw a logo or letter E. Art direction: precise contemporary editorial vector-style graphics, clean cut shapes with purposeful overlapping planes and slight offset darker shapes for dimensionality. Mature, composed, clear, visually elevated. Use royal blue #1b3b87, deep blue #142f70, pale blue #e8eef9, off-white #fbfcfc and restrained amber #d9ad1d. No open book, books, desk scene, person, text, numbers, watermark, app screenshots, dashboards, charts, checkmarks, badges, obvious gradients, glossy plastic, photorealism or generic floating blobs. No real source documents or data. Asset: isolated abstract decorative composition with transparent background, landscape ratio 2:1. A unified interlocking structure of three broad folded paper ribbons and a single small amber fold; architectural and asymmetrical, gently rising toward the right. Strong silhouette, generous clear margins, sparse enough to look beautiful at 320px wide. Two or three planes with deeper blue underfolds create tangible relief. Avoid literal documents, tiny scribbles and clutter. This is a reusable cutout, not a presentation board.

assets.name: 07-icon-concepts
assets.prompt: Create a bespoke visual asset for EquipED's faculty dashboard only, an academic learning-material review workspace. This belongs to a coordinated asset family inspired by folded paper and the Folio logo's corner fold, but DO NOT draw a logo or letter E. Art direction: precise contemporary editorial vector-style graphics, clean cut shapes with purposeful overlapping planes and slight offset darker shapes for dimensionality. Mature, composed, clear, visually elevated. Use royal blue #1b3b87, deep blue #142f70, pale blue #e8eef9, off-white #fbfcfc and restrained amber #d9ad1d. No open book, books, desk scene, person, text, numbers, watermark, app screenshots, dashboards, charts, checkmarks, badges, obvious gradients, glossy plastic, photorealism or generic floating blobs. No real source documents or data. Asset: a cohesive collection of SIX custom spot-icon concepts arranged evenly in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid on fully transparent background. Each icon large with substantial transparent separation; no boxes enclosing the icons. Sequence: top-left a closed learning-module folio with amber corner; top-middle a disciplined content-review page with magnifier; top-right a set of aligned syllabus sheets with a slim linking bracket; bottom-left curriculum represented by three linked rectangular outline nodes; bottom-middle a folded record sheet with a small clock; bottom-right an annotation pencil marking a single page. Shared consistent three-quarter perspective, sturdy simple blue silhouettes, paper-white cutouts and at most one tiny amber accent per icon. Refined vector-like geometry, consistent stroke and visual weight, no tiny lines or text. Functional navigation icons, expressive yet restrained, no glossy rendering. This is an icon exploration sheet; do not add titles, labels, numerals or grid rules.

iconRefinementPrompt: Edit the last image, the six-icon exploration sheet. Preserve the six subjects and 3-by-2 layout, but completely REMOVE the dark background, every glow, bloom, halo, light spill, and shadow behind objects. Output true transparent background with no painted pixels between icons. Rebuild the rendering as crisp FLAT VECTOR-STYLE editorial icons using solid #1b3b87, #142f70, #e8eef9, #fbfcfc and very small #d9ad1d accents. No gradients, texture, glossy plastic, 3D extrusion or environmental lighting; simple cut shapes and clean corners, slightly layered planes only. Icons must remain crisp and readable at small sizes. Top left: closed module with folded corner, top middle: page and magnifier, top right: aligned syllabus sheets with bracket, bottom left: linked curriculum nodes, bottom middle: history page with clock, bottom right: annotation pencil and page. No text, no labels, no grid rules, no open books.
